promotion_basis: The frozen v104 review found 23 buyer walkaways, including 10 in round 1 and visible positive-surplus cases where a legal counter remained available, plus accepted agreements retaining only 1/500000 or 0.01/3000 of visible joint surplus. The same run recorded 128 conditional-twin failures because a single legal counteroffer was sent to a service whose contract requires 2 to 5 candidates. V2.14 adds a narrow visible-arithmetic buyer counter-first guard; the single-counter transport repair is executable engine v2.10 behavior covered by the same cutover.
